newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 8.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 8.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Opposition parties said the four billion forints the government plans to give to bail out indebted hospitals is too little.
- Finance MInister Peter Medgyessy said that in 1997 the bulk of agricultural subsidies will be given to the producers, not the commercialisers.
- Dutch ABN AMRO Bank has bought a majority stake in Hungary's Magyar Hitel Bank.
- Budapest Bank forecasts 19 to 21 percent inflation and one to three percent GDP growth for 1997.
- Recsk ore mine privatisation tender deadline has been extended to December 4.
